plain_summary: This page details booking deposits required for drydocks, floating docks, and slipways at the Ports of Durban, Mossel Bay, and Port Elizabeth. It outlines penalties for booking cancellations within 60 days or for vessels exceeding their allocated occupancy period, incurring a 40% penalty for every 12-hour overstay. Additionally, it specifies preparation fees for drydocks and floating docks at the Ports of Cape Town, East London, and Durban. For Cape Town and East London, these preparation fees are tiered based on the vessel's gross tonnage in cubic metres.
